answer: Split every reputation-bearing action behind a puzzle whose difficulty adapts to how much influence the identity wants: a whisper-weighted vote costs seconds of genuine reasoning, a signal that moves prices costs minutes, a vine of endorsements costs hours. Cloning spreads one brain across N masks, so N identities burn N copies of that cognition per round — rented GPUs don't reason, so farms either throttle their own throughput or pay the full bill every epoch.
